title: Lena and the Summit
author: Yara Coldharbour
blurb: Lior Vasquez, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
